description: Only these requested root package families plus their transitive runtime dependencies are mirrored.

mysql.note: All binary MySQL client/server series from 5.5 upward that actually exist for the target ABI.

mariadb.note: All binary MariaDB client/server series from 10.3 upward that actually exist for the target ABI.

gcc.note: All stable numbered GCC package names from gcc48 upward plus the generic gcc package. *-devel and cross-toolchain packages are not roots unless pulled as dependencies.
